fields.h1: Build Renewal Reminder Automation Before Anything Lapses
fields.hero_description: Build renewal reminder automation that emails the owner before a contract, plan, license, or membership renews, then escalates.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into Every Renewal
fields.features_subheading: Each renewal is one record with a date and an owner, and its reminders stop once it is renewed.
fields.feature_1:
One record for every renewal date

Emergent builds the renewal database from your prompt. Each record holds its end date and owner, plus a status that shows where the renewal stands, in a database you own.
fields.feature_2:
Reminders counted back from the date

Set the schedule once, such as 90, 30, and 7 days before a renewal. The app sends each reminder by email or as a Slack message on the right day for each record you track.
fields.feature_3:
An escalation when nobody acts

If the owner has not marked a renewal handled by the last reminder, the app alerts the next person you name. That alert links the record and names the owner who has not replied.
fields.feature_4:
Dates synced from the tools you use

Connect your CRM, billing tool, or HR system through its API, and the app pulls renewal dates in as they change. A plan moved to quarterly gets a new date and schedule.
fields.feature_5:
Renewed documents read into the record

When someone uploads a renewed license or a signed contract, the app reads its new expiry date with AI. A date it cannot read with confidence goes to a person to check.
fields.feature_6:
The renewal app's code, in your GitHub

Export the full code to your GitHub repository on paid plans. Anyone on the team can read every reminder rule and change the schedule logic like any codebase they maintain.

fields.tab_content_1:
On December 31, the Hartwell renewal lands with Teodor

Bramblecote IT Services tracks every client contract. Hartwell Dental Group's ends on March 31, so on December 31, 90 days out, the app sends account manager Teodor Varga a renewal task. If the task is still open on March 1, 30 days out, his manager Ines Albrecht gets a Slack alert.
fields.tab_content_2:
Odalys changes her $240 plan before it renews

Fernhollow Coffee Roasters sells its beans on an annual subscription. Odalys Brennecke's $240 plan renews on November 14, so on October 15, 30 days ahead, the app emails her the amount and date, with a link to manage the plan. She switches to a quarterly plan, and her record shows the change.
fields.tab_content_3:
The renewed license from Desmond stops the reminders

Larkspur Electric tracks the license of every electrician it sends to a job. Desmond Okafor-Reyes's license expires on June 30, so on May 1, 60 days out, the app emails him a link to upload the renewed one. It reads the new expiry date, June 30, 2028, from his upload and marks his record current.
fields.tab_content_4:
408 of 480 members renewed, and 72 get a final email

Quillmere Woodworkers Guild runs on a calendar year, and every membership ends on December 31. Members get a reminder 30 days before and another 7 days before. By the end date, 408 members have renewed, out of 480. The app moves the other 72 to a lapsed list and sends each one a final email on January 7.

fields.howto_title: How to Build Renewal Reminder Automation
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to give every renewal a date and an owner, then build the renewal reminder automation in Emergent.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Pick the date reminders count from
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Name who hears about a stalled one
fields.howto_step_1_des: Put contracts, subscriptions, licenses, and memberships into one list. For each one, note the end date, any notice date the agreement sets, and the person who renews it. Give every renewal without an owner one before you build.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Count back from the notice date when an agreement has one, and from the end date when it does not. Store that date as its own field on the record. When the date moves, every reminder moves with it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Choose the days before that date when each reminder goes out, such as 90 and 30 for a client contract or 30 for a subscriber. Leave more lead time for a renewal that needs a new price or a signature.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Decide who gets an alert when the owner has not acted by the last reminder, and how it reaches them. Address it to one named person, not a shared channel. A message with a name on it has an owner.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the app in a prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste your renewal list and escalation rule into a prompt in plain English. Emergent builds the renewal database with its reminders and a dashboard, and you change any rule later by asking for the change.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Connect the tools that hold the dates
fields.howto_step_6_des: Find the system of record for each kind of renewal and connect it through its API. Map each date field once, and a date changed there resets the reminders that count back from it.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test with renewals due this quarter
fields.howto_step_7_des: Load 5 renewals due in the next 90 days, including one with no owner. Check that each reminder arrives on the right day, and that marking a renewal done stops the reminders still scheduled for it.

faq_plan.a: Renewal reminder automation is software that tracks the date each contract, subscription, license, or membership renews and sends reminders on a schedule counted back from that date. Each reminder goes to the person responsible, and the reminders stop once the record is marked renewed.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up renewal reminder automation?
faq_plan.a: List your renewals with their dates and owners, pick the days before each date when reminders go out, and choose who is alerted when an owner does not act. Describe that in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder, and it builds the database and the reminders around it.

faq_plan.q: When should renewal reminder automation send the first reminder?
faq_plan.a: Send it as far ahead as the renewal's work requires. Give a client contract that needs a new price 90 days, a license that takes paperwork 60 days, and an annual subscription 30 days. Then add one shorter reminder close to the date. Emergent has no task cap, and extra reminders on each record count against no limit.

faq_plan.q: Can renewal reminder automation read the end date from a signed contract?
faq_plan.a: Yes. When a signed contract is uploaded, the app can read its end date and notice date into fields with AI. You confirm a low-confidence date before the app schedules any reminder from it. For other document workflows, see pdf automation.

faq_plan.q: What should a subscription email from renewal reminder automation say?
faq_plan.a: Say the renewal date, the amount, the plan that renews, and a link to change or cancel it. Put the date and the amount in the first line. Send it from an address the subscriber already knows, not one they have never seen.

faq_plan.q: How does renewal reminder automation stop once something is renewed?
faq_plan.a: The reminders stop when the record's status changes to renewed. The owner can mark it done, or the app can set it when a new end date arrives from your billing tool or an uploaded document. Every reminder still scheduled for that record is canceled, and the status history stays in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Who should renewal reminder automation alert first for a client contract?
faq_plan.a: Alert the account manager first. An internal reminder 90 days out gives that person time to prepare terms before contacting the client with an offer. When that offer needs a priced document, see proposal automation for building the quote itself.

faq_plan.q: Can renewal reminder automation track employee licenses and certifications?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Give each employee a record listing every license and certification they hold, with its expiry date. Send a reminder 60 days out asking for the renewed copy, read the new expiry date from the upload, and give managers a view of anyone within 30 days of an expiry.

faq_plan.q: What should renewal reminder automation do after a membership lapses?
faq_plan.a: It should follow a rule you set. One option moves the member to a lapsed list on the end date, sends a final email a week later, and keeps their history on the record for a late renewal. Emergent builds that rule from your prompt, and you change it by prompting.

faq_plan.q: Should renewal reminder automation send reminders with my member newsletter?
faq_plan.a: No. Send each renewal reminder on its own, timed to that member's renewal date, not inside a scheduled broadcast to everyone. Broadcasts to the whole list belong to newsletter automation, which runs on a shared calendar instead of each record's date.

Appointment reminders, general notifications and vendor reviews stay on their own pages.
